name: StudyBuddy
title: Study Buddy
about: Study Buddy, the course's capstone app, built the way the module teaches: a testable architecture, Swift Testing and UI tests, debugging with Logger, performance and accessibility, a Spanish translation, and everything a release needs.
notes: Command-U runs both the unit tests and the UI tests.
Add the launch arguments -AppleLanguages (es) to see the app in Spanish.
Add the launch argument -ui-testing to start from known sample data.
